lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: I'm so sleepy…

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: It's only 6:24 a.m. I still have more than an hour before my shift starts.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Did I arrive a little too early?

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Morning, Avril. Did you sleep well last night?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: The monster I fought last night was a real pain. By the time I got back to my apartment, it was already late, and after taking a shower it was past two in the morning.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Anyway, I'd better get everything ready for the shift handover…

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: You don't look so great either. What happened at the café yesterday?

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: A drunk guy came in during the early hours of the morning and asked for a hot milk to sober up.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: But he had obviously drunk way too much. I'm absolutely sure he never threw up in the restroom at the bar before coming here.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: One more glass of hot milk would've made his stomach explode.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: I think I already know where this is going.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: He barely took a few sips before he started vomiting. Luckily, I saw it coming the moment I handed him the milk.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: The instant he lifted his head and looked like he was about to puke, I punched him right in the face.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: ...Fair enough.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: That way, none of the vomit splashed onto the furniture. It all landed neatly on the floor.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Cleaning up the mess, and dragging that unconscious drunk out, took a ridiculous amount of effort.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Then I still had to calm down the other frightened customers.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Compared to that, I'd rather fight two more monsters like the one from last night than deal with an idiot like him.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Honestly, I should ask the boss to hire another server or two…

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Or maybe just hand in my resignation.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: No, no, senpai—you can't leave yet!

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: I'm still not familiar with how the café operates. At least when the boss was around, he could guide me.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: The boss had to return to headquarters for a few days, so you're the only one left who can help me.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: My paycheck has already been docked so many times because of my mistakes that there's barely anything left.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Well, well... I guess I just can't say no to such an adorable kohai.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Alright then, let's go through the workflow one more time.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Well then, I'm heading out. If you run into any problems, just give me a call.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Got it, senpai! Thanks for all your help!

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (It's almost time for the shift handover. Today went pretty smoothly. Hopefully things will keep going this well even without the boss and Senior around to help me.)

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Good work today, Avril.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Looks like you managed to get through the day without any major mistakes.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Anyway, you should get ready and head out.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Let's hope both of us have a peaceful night tonight.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: That would be wonderful.

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: That would be wonderful!

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: That would be wonderful!!

lines.speaker: Xiaoti
lines.text: Safe travels.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Roger that.
